# DSV4 mHC uses TileLang by default. apache-tvm-ffi 0.1.11+ is
# incompatible with the TVM bundled in this TileLang wheel.
https://rtp-maga.cn-zhangjiakou.oss.aliyuncs.com/rtp_llm/arm_pkg/tilelang-0.1.9%2Bcuda.git441c3b06-cp38-abi3-linux_aarch64.whl
# apache-tvm-ffi 0.1.11+ dropped the hasattr() guard in registry._add_class_attrs,
# so it re-registers fields inherited from ancestor types (ir.Type.span et al) onto
# the TVM bundled in the TileLang wheel above and dies with "attribute '__dict__' of
# 'type' objects is not writable". 0.1.10 matches the x86 cuda13 lock.
apache-tvm-ffi==0.1.10
https://rtp-maga.cn-zhangjiakou.oss.aliyuncs.com/rtp_llm/arm_pkg/z3_solver-4.13.0.0%2Blocal.ali-py2.py3-none-manylinux2014_aarch64.whl
https://search-ad.oss-cn-hangzhou-zmf-internal.aliyuncs.com/rtp-llm-deps/arm_pkg/tile_kernels-0.1.dev0%2Bali.git36d9e45-py3-none-any.whl

safetensors==0.7.0
tabulate==0.9.0
